history.text: We're about to launch our developer tools beta next week. I want to find the right early adopters and potential partners before we go public with it. People building in the AI-agent space, devtool founders, anyone who might be a good fit to try it early or co-promote.
Got it. Should I just flag people and context, or do you want me to suggest how to reach out too?

Both. If you spot someone relevant, tell me who they are, why they're a fit, and a lightweight way I could open the conversation. I don't want anything that feels like a cold pitch — more like a natural reason to connect.
Warm and contextual, not salesy. I'll keep the suggestions natural.

Also keep an eye out for any relevant events, Twitter threads, or community discussions where our beta would be on-topic. Sometimes the best intros come from jumping into a conversation at the right moment.
Will do — I'll watch for live conversations where showing up would feel organic rather than forced.
Great. I'll be heads-down on product stuff this morning, so just queue things up and I'll check in when I come up for air.
I'll have a list ready. Go build.
